title: qa/basis/<id>.md frontmatter
description: One work item, read from a tracker by an intake adapter, or brought in by intake-manual when no tracker holds it. The test basis for everything downstream.

origin.description: Where a manual work item came from, such as `qa/risk-register.md R-product-1` or `request in chat`.

acceptance_criteria.description: Required even when empty: an empty list is a finding for the basis review, a missing key is an adapter bug.

created_at.description: When a manual work item was brought in.
